# v2 XML encoding fixtures

Synthetic HL7 v2 messages, each in the pipe-delimited encoding (`.hl7`, `\r`-separated) and in
the v2 XML encoding (`.xml`). Every name, identifier, address and code is made up: the two ORU
messages were generated by `@cosyte/synth` (`generateOru` with seeds 500 and 501), then edited by
hand to add a second identifier, an explicit null, notes and the message structure in MSH-9.3,
and to use the names, dates of birth and addresses `scripts/phi-allow-list.txt` declares.

These are our own test vectors, not the examples published with the HL7 v2 XML encoding
specification, which we did not have when they were written.

| File | Version | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `oru-r01-v25` | 2.5 | The writer's own layout: one segment per line, no groups. `toHl7Xml` writes the `.xml` byte for byte from the `.hl7` with the data types `xmlDataTypes` reads from the `.xml`. |
| `oru-r01-v26-grouped` | 2.6 | Indented, with group elements, a comment, a repeated field, an explicit null, a CDATA section, entity and character references and a line break. |
| `adt-a01-v27` | 2.7 | A five-character MSH-2 that declares the truncation character, and a value holding it. |
